latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Text to Video: Human to Human

- Instantly turn text scripts (TXT, DOCX, PDF, up to 500MB) into 1080p MP4 talking head videos with a realistic AI presenter.
- No manual sliders or video skills required — just upload your script, give a prompt, and download.
- Cloud rendering pipeline: automatic session setup, secure anonymous token, and credit system (100 free credits, 7-day expiry for new users).
- Clear, step-by-step workflows for uploading, editing, exporting, and tracking project state.
- Supports batch processing, iterative refinement, various formats (mp4, mov, avi, webm, etc.), and fast turnaround (typically 1–3 minutes per video).
- Helpful error handling, tips, and self-service troubleshooting included.
